entries.message: This update includes add optional Up Next provider sync and stop an older alpha branch being reported as a newer build.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Adds optional Up Next provider sync controls to onboarding and Sync Tuning, with clear 6% marker guidance.

Stop an alpha install being told a newer build is available when the alpha branch is actually behind it, which showed the previous release's builds as "not pulled yet" and reported a newer build with the same number you were already running
Keep listing genuinely newer alpha builds, and every build of a newer release cycle, exactly as before
messageFragments: Feature - Add optional Up Next provider sync
Fix - Stop an older alpha branch being reported as a newer build
